LESSON: SPEED READING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.1 Extensive Reading (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the lea
Topic 2.2: Speed Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Speed Reading. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What can you do to improve your reading fluency?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify main information from given texts for comprehension

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify main information from given texts for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can identify main information from given texts for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Speed Reading using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Speed Reading in the examples.
2. Explain Speed Reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Speed Reading.
4. Show that you can: identify main information from given texts for comprehension

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Speed Reading using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Speed Reading important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read out a list of family members (Vater, Mutter, Eltern, Kind, Sohn, Tochter, Bruder, Schwester, Oma, Opa, Onkel, usw),
2. Read out information about peers nuclear and extended family members (z.B Sein/Ihr Vater heißt ____. Seine/Ihre Mutter heißt___), and answer questions
3. Read profiles made by peers about their family members (z.B. Das ist mein Vater/meine Mutter. Er/sie ist fünfzig Jahre alt),

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify main information from given texts for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
